balls.text: Finishes off in style! Almost a replay of the last delivery. This was not as short, but it matters not for Miller who sends it into the stands in front of square! Lucknow Super Giants finish on 209
Miller finally connects! Slower bouncer on leg, but Miller expected this, waited on it and pulled it away into the upper tier over the square leg boundary
Beats Miller again with a pace-off short ball. Excellent stuff from the experienced seamer
Slower bouncer angled across, Miller can only slap it towards mid-off
Miller can't connect cleanly as he looks to take on this full ball outside off. Long-off comes across to collect
Slower ball angled across, Miller can't reach it. This time it's called wide
Full and wide, Mohit keeps it out of Miller's arc as he looks to drive it inside out and misses
Castled! Bishnoi looks to make room and play it on the off side but Starc nails the yorker and middle and off stump are uprooted! Who says Starc only shows up in the knockouts?
Bishnoi has to duck out of the way as Starcfires in a bouncer

Aaaand Starc has his second! Cramps him for room with a well-directed bouncer, at 141kph to hurry him too. Shahbaz looks to pull but only manages the top edge and Tripurana at backward square leg backtracks and holds on comfortably
Shahbaz gets enough on that! Full outside off, hint of reverse-swing again, but Shahbaz swings it away in front of square. One-bounce four
Full outside off and Miller swings it off the bottom half to deep midwicket
Full down leg, Shahbaz flicks it aerially and it drops just short of the deep fine leg fielder, who can't collect cleanly but is lucky it doesn't go behind for four
Slower ball on a length around off stays low and Miller only manages an under-edge through to Porel as he swings across the line
On a length on off, Shahbaz cuts it very fine to short third
Short ball angled across, Miller pulls it out to deep midwicket on the bounce
Full toss at a height across Miller, who slashes it fine on the off side. Flies over the infield and fetches Miller a much-needed boundary. And that's called no-ball for height
Length ball angled across, Shahbaz can't clear backward point as he looks to steer it behind square on the off side
Dug in short on leg, Miller stands tall, waits on that slower ball from his former GT team-mate and pulls it out to deep midwicket
Full outside off, driven out to deep point
On a length around off, Shahbaz hangs back and clips it into that vacant midwicket region for a quick run
Wrong'un on a length around off, Shahbaz nudges it towards short fine

Full outside off, driven to cover. They risk a single and Shardul is turned back by Miller. The throw is quick and Porel is also quick to crash his gloves into the stumps after collecting. Shardul well short! And LSG are crumbling in a heap!
Misses the sweep as Kuldeep tosses it up on a length on off

Can Badoni take Kuldeep on and clear the ropes? No he can't! Comes down the track as Kuldeep floats this up outside off. Comes off the bottom half of the bat and it only goes to Stubbs at long-on, who holds on with ease

Tossed full on leg, Miller mises his flick as the ball goes off the pads towards short third. Kuldeep is up in appeal, it's turned down. After a chat, Axar is convinced to review it. There's no outside edge, with the ball spinning in. Did that pitch in line? Nope, outside leg. Capitals lose both their reviews now
On a length outside leg, Miller can only clip it out to deep backward square. Axar continues a good phase for Capitals
Tucked out to deep backward square
Length ball angled across Miller, who cuts it away to deep cover

Risky single as Badoni comes down the track and pushes it to cover. Miller was off for the run while Badoni was hesitating. Miller runs through and puts in the dive as Porel takes the bails off. But Miller made it back in time
Full on leg, eased through midwicket
Badoni eases a length ball outside off to cover point's right for a single
Full toss outside off, Badoni works it down to long-on
Knocks him over! Did that reverse a touch? It's a 140kph full ball around off that beats Pooran's swing and flattens off stump! Pooran walks back for a 30-ball 75, shaking his head
Full outside off, Miller drives it out to deep cover
Dug in short, Pooran pulls it behind square leg. Mukesh Kumar misjudges it and has to change direction to stop that. But he seems to have hurt his ankle! He immediately goes off to receive treatment

What was that? It's a full toss at almost shoulder height. Pooran was moving across to scoop but adjusts to just ramp it over a diving wicketkeeper. Pooran reviews it for the height of the no-ball. He was crouching when the ball passed him. The umpires check for his height while upright and comparing it to the height of the ball. And it's noted to be a fair delivery!
Short and wide, Miller slaps it away to deep backward point
Full on off, Miller prods at it and it goes through backward square off the inside edge. Denies Kuldeep a wicket maiden, but what an over from him nonetheless!
Kuldeep starts off to him with a googly outside off that spins in from a length. Miller pushes it out towards cover

Pant falls for a six-ball duck on LSG debut! The pressure was building, of course, and Pant goes for the big shot. But it's spinning away so it comes off the toe end and Faf du Plessis doesn't drop those at long-off
Tossed full on leg, Pant can only help it to short fine. He's still not scored, off five balls
Tossed up full and Pant looks for the reverse-sweep, but it spins away to beat the bat
Kuldeep bowls this on a length outside off, Pant can't reach it

And now Pooran drills him down the ground, beating a diving long-off fielder to his left to take 28 off that over! Stubbs went too full again and at this point, it feels like wherever he was going to bowl, Pooran's intentions weren't going to change
FOUR IN A ROW! Full outside off and Pooran creams it over extra cover! Stubbs is getting the part-timer's treatment!
Hat-trick! Stubbs pulls his length back but it doesn't make any difference to Pooran who stands tall and deposits it over the ropes wide of long-on
Two in a row! Pooran gets another one in the slot and this time hammers it straight down the ground. Brings up a 24-ball half-century! His tenth in the IPL!
Swung away in style! Full on middle and Pooran brings out the slog sweep in front of square. Goes all the way!
Floated full on middle, Pooran looks to work it leg side and gets an inside edge onto his foot
Full on middle, Pant clips it towards mid-on. Pooran slips at the non-striker's end but he was close enough to the crease
Full around off, Pant meets it with a block towards mid-off

Picks out long-on. Back of length outside off, it's a slower ball too, and Marsh looks to pull this down the ground. It comes off the toe end and Tristan Stubbs makes no mistake. Finally a breakthrough for Delhi Capitals. A stunning knock against his old team comes to an end
Length ball into his body cramps Pooran for room as he looks to swing this away. Can only miscue it to the vacant midwicket region
Yorker on the stumps and Marsh is able to dig it out to long-on
Shot! This is a slower ball, but overpitched outside off. Marsh gets low and goes inside out over cover and into the stands!
Slower ball, on a length, angled across Pooran, who pulls out of his shot. Umpire doesn't give it a wide. Pooran wears a disappointed look on his face, but doesn't review
Full outside off, Marsh gets an inside edge to deep backward square as he swings big
Low full toss outside off, Pooran eases it down to long-off
Mohit digs in a slower ball into the pitch. Marsh is very early on the shot and it deflects off his abdomen towards the leg side. They get a single away
Slower ball angled across Pooran, who slaps it down to long-on
Swatted away! Angles in a length ball from outside off, Pooran gets low and hacks it away in front of square leg. The fielder in the deep stood no chance
Spins away from a length, patted in front of cover
Quicker one on a length, clipped through midwicket
Marsh goes high... and long! Tossed up generously, wide outside off, it is the googly. Marsh slogs it, gets more height than distance, but that is enough. Did not time it well but gets it all the way
Spins in from a fullish length outside off, 88.6kph, punched to cover
Shortish and wide outside off, cut to point
Tossed up on off, driven just wide of cover
Very full on off, digs it out between his legs, ten off Mohit's first over
My word. Some shot that. It is the slwoer one on a length outside off, just 103.1kph, Marsh delays his shot and cuts it past backward point
Length ball on middle and leg, heaved away to deep square leg
Full and just outside off, powered down to long-on
Bangs it short and just outside off, 128.4kph, Marsh sways away, called wide for height
Very full outside off, squeezed to sweeper cover
Offcutter on a short length, jags well away from Pooran and outside the tramline
Full toss on middle, punched through midwicket
Loopy ball on off, defended off the front foot

Work to do for Starc, but it is too much. Fuller on off again, Pooran goes for the sweep and gets it just wide of short fine leg. Deep square leg covers enough ground but it is not enough. Fifty of the partnership up already
Turn for Kuldeep and Pooran misses the sweep
Nails the sweep! Tossed up full and just outside off, he takes a massive stride to sweep it through backward square leg. The man in the deep couldn't get around
Googly angling away from him, slashed to deep cover
Quicker legbreak on off, he goes back and defends with a straight blade
Rubbing salt into the wounds, Pooran style! Clears the front leg and tonks it straight over the bowler to take 25 off the over, hitting a maximum right after he was dropped

WHAT HAVE YOU DONE, RIZVI??? Nigam had just about got the googly working. Pooran looks to slash it over cover but gets a thick outside edge in the air and towards the right of backward point, who makes a mess
Pooran power in attendance! The googly at a short of length, enough time for Pooran to go back and heave it over deep midwicket
Pooran joins the six show now. Tossed up ball just outside off, in his slot as it is the legbreak at 90.5kph, he clears his front leg and sends it sailing into the sight-screen
Wider and fuller outside off, 88.6kph, slogged to deep midwicket to bring up a 21-ball half-century
Marsh deposits it well over deep midwicket He goes back to the half-tracker and heaves it miles in the air
Length ball on off and middle, 136.5kph, defended down the track. LSG end the powerplay on 64 for 1
Yorker on off, dug out to mid-on
Short again, pulls it again, four more! Gift after gift for Marsh. This barely raises stomach high, easy pickings for Marsh, who pulls to deep backward square leg
Marsh, pulls, six! The story of the evening so far. This is short again but only at 132.6kph, he picks the length early and swings across the line to pepper the deep backward square leg boundary
On a length on off and middle, 132.4kph he taps it to the on side in front of square and gets to the other end
Angling in on a length on middle and leg, 130.6kph, clipped to short fine leg, who misfields it
There was a tickle or so Mukesh thinks. Umpire calls it wide and DC don't challenge as Marsh swings and misses
Beauty of a delivery, but runs for Pooran! He hangs back to defend but ends up playing down the wrong line. The ball bounces and takes a thick outside edge that beats short third, fifty up for LSG
Quicker length ball wide outside off, chopped to point

Picks out long-off to perfection! Nigam has his first IPL wicket on his fourth ball, DC congregate to celebrate. Tossed up around off, he entices the big shot from Markram. It was the googly, Markram went for the loft over long-off but miscued it off the inner half straight to Starc
Extra bounce from a length, catches Marsh by surprise, gets a thick inside edge towards short fine leg
Marsh continues his merry ways of the pull. This is slightly short on leg, he gets down on a leg to swipe it away through backward square leg
Length ball on leg to begin, clipped through forward square leg
Digs it in again, outside off, punched through cover for a couple
Shortish but angling in, 96.7kph, punched to cover off the back foot again
Quicker and angling in, 97.2kph, punched to cover

Huge appeal but perhaps sliding down. Marsh gets down to slog but misses and is hit on the back leg. Axar chats to Porel and signals for the review. Not too close to review, per my naked eye. Marsh was way early with his swing and missed the ball completely. It perhaps was the arm ball, and as a result would have been sliding down leg, DC lose a review
Pummelled away! Not too short, as he lands it on a length outside off at 96.kph. Marsh stays leg side and just powers it through backward point
Lands it on a length on off, 96.6kph, he goes back to punch it to long-off
Goes for the yorker but dishes out a low full toss that he can only toe-end to mid-off. 21 off the Starc over, LSG are flying
Not off the meat but still gets the desired result. Short and angling in, barely rising. Marsh gets it off the inner half and hits it through bakward square leg
Free swing of the bat and it is six more! Marsh is having a ball in Vizag. In the slot on middle and leg, 142.4kph, he gets under it and plonks it into the deep midwicket stands
Marsh is enjoying Starc's pace and that is showing. Short on middle, not much bite on it, 134.6kph. Marsh stays put and pulls it over backward square leg to beat the man in the deep to his right
Full on leg, 144.3kph, flicked to mid-on for a quick one
Humongous shot! Markram backs away to the length ball, 144.6kph, and lofts it over mid-off
Darts it in on off, he hurriedly keeps it out to backward point. Good comeback from Axar after that early four
Slows it down and lands it on a length on off, Marsh punches it to cover
Quicker and flatter length ball on middle, 94.1kph, he gets behind it to keep it out
Fuller on middle, punched straight to cover for a quick run. Du Plessis dives to his right and stops that
Finds the gap does Markram! Not much room given but he manufactures it by staying leg side of the ball and delaying his slash, gets it between point and cover
Flatter and on a length outside off, slapped to cover
Marsh is here, ladies and gents! Swings the first ball he faces in IPL 2025 over the deep midwicket ropes. Length ball on leg, 144.7kph, he connects that and how!
Markram charges down while backing away to the 144.7kph length ball, gets a thick inside edge onto his back leg. They steal a run as it rolls to the off side
Bouncer in the opening over! Markram thinks of ducking but then goes for the pull, misses as the 141.9kph bullet goes over his blade
Shortish on leg, 143.4kph, glanced to short midwicket
Shaping in a touch from a length around middle, Markram solidly blocks it towards cover
Begins with a length ball around off, that Markram gets behind and blocks to the off side

And he has won it for Delhi Capitals! He brings out a KEvin Pietersen celebration as he hammers this slot ball into the sight screen! Oh, what a thriller. This is why Capitals bought Ashutosh. This is what he did for Punjab Kings last season. And he has done it in his first game for his new team. He was on 19 off 19 and he finishes on 66 off 31 to win a humdinger for his team
They get the single. It's full around off, Mohit pushes it towards point and takes off. Badoni can't collect cleanly so they complete the run with ease. Five needed off four now!

Mohit misses his flick as the Shahbaz bowls a beauty that spins away. Pant can't collect or this game would have been over. But Pant has also reviewed it for leg before. And that's missing off stump. The game is still alive! Will Pant's fumble cost them here?
Low full toss on off, Ashutosh just flicks it through midwicket and it's too wide for long-on. Six needed off the last over now!

Pooran's excellent effort goes in vain and Ashutosh has six Slot ball outside off and he lofts this down the ground. Pooran on the rope had to dive back to try and stop that, but it was just beyond him
Lands safe! Looks to whip away this low full toss on middle and off, doesn't get it cleanly and it falls between the two fielders. They manage to race for two, bringing up fifty for Ashutosh

Kuldeep is run out! They take a gamble, and it doesn't pay off. Kuldeep misses this full ball angled across, but they take off to try and steal a run, mostly with the intent of getting Ashutosh on strike. Pant throws, misses the stumps but it goes to Prince Yadav, who is quick to gather, turn and throw down the stumps at the non-striker's end. They managed to cross over so Ashutosh will have strike
Prince now nails the wide yorker and Kuldeep can't get bat on ball
Ashutosh takes off for a single before the ball even reaches Kuldeep, but that's not even necessary! Kuldeep glides this length ball, using the pace, fine on the off side and beats deep third!
Into the sightscreen again! Bishnoi reverts to bowling over the wicket, but this is too full and too wide. He frees his arms, gets low and clobbers this!
And now drilled through cover! Too much width, and too short too, and he slaps it away! Ashutosh says the game is still on!
In the slot and Ashutosh hammers this down the ground! Clean hit into the sight screen
They get a quick single to cover
Kuldeep looks to slap away a length ball angled across him and gets a bottom edge that Pant collects. Playfully pushes Kuldeep over as he was balancing his back leg in the crease

High in the air, and Pant settles under it! It's a googly, full outside off and spinning away from Starc who goes for a big swing. Only skies it and Pant claims it immediately as he runs to his left and pouches it
Rathi goes short again. Starc reads the googly and punches it out towards backward point. They do well to quickly take a single
Googly, full outside off, and it beats the bat as Starc has a big swing
Ashutosh looks to pull away this short-ish ball outside off, gets a bottom edge towards short third. They sprint for the single
Length ball angled across and Starc punches it out to cover
Slides a length ball across him that Starc pushes at but can't connect

And Digvesh gets the breakthrough! It's a carrom ball on a length on leg, Nigam was looking to flick it leg side and it gets a top edge. Short fine moves to his right to take it comfortably and an excellent, excellent knock on debut comes to an end. Well played, Vipraj Nigam
Driven out to deep cover to end a 20-run over!
Even the edge goes for four now! Full around middle, Nigam had backed away and looking to play it on the off side, steering it in the gap between backward point and short third!

Oh, what a shot! Vipraj Nigam has come to play, and how! Backs away, gets a full ball just outside off and slaps it away flat over cover for another one-bounce four. Fifty-ball stand is up in just 19 balls!
Prince responds with a yorker that Ashutosh manages to squeeze out to the leg side
Beats mid-off! This is full on leg, Ashutosh backs away and drills it to the fielder's left, beating his dive!
Ashutosh seems to be finding his groove indeed! Banged in short around off and he swivels and helps it along over fine leg!
On a length outside off, it spins away as Ashutosh pushes at it. He gets an edge and it goes off Pant's gloves to short third. Technically, that's a chance gone begging!
Slapped out to long-off's left for a single
Goes downtown in style! A drag down again from Shahbaz and this time Nigam makes no mistake as he pummels it down the ground, even with one hand coming off the bat. Right in front of Pant too!
On a length outside off, it spins away as Pant falls while collecting. Called wide and rightly so
Short-ish again and Ashutosh pulls it to deep midwicket's left
This time Nigam miscues it as he goes down the ground, but it lands well short of long-on running in. This was short outside off and he looked to flat-bat it down the ground
Vipraj Nigam keeps targeting the off side! Backs away to this length ball around off and lofts it over cover. Beats the two deep fielders converging
Full outside off, eased towards point for an easy run
Creamed over cover! Slot ball outside off and Nigam picks the bones out of that one. Gets low and hammers it inside out
Bishnoi tosses it wide again to Nigam and this time he slaps it away in front of square! One bounce and four
Not quite a drag down but Ashutosh rocks back and pulls it in front of square. Goes to deep midwicket's left on the bounce
On a length outside off, Nigam waits on it and just taps it towards short third for a quick run
Vipraj Nigam sees some width on offer and slices it over backward point! This was tossed up full outside off, Nigam reached out and got it over the infielder
ON a length on leg, it grips and pops up to the leg side as it hits high on the bat, with Nigam looking to tuck it leg side
On a length on off, Ashutosh drives to cover
Tossed up full and Vipraj is able to drive this away to deep cover

What a comeback! On a length on leg, it spins back in as Stubbs misses his flick. Goes off his pad onto the stumps and Siddharth sprints away in celebration. The ball change does the trick for Lucknow!
Stubbs goes massive again! Was this even bigger? Tossed up too full on off and he almost clears the stadium as he goes downtown! 98 metres, this one!
Huuuuuuuge hit! Gets one in the slot, clears his front leg and absolutely hammers this down the ground. This flew 90 metres!
Full on off, 137kph, punched to mid-off for a quick run
Full on the stumps, punched out to mid-off. 100 up for DC
Full around middle, worked down the ground to long-on
Yorker on the stumps, 138.9kph, Stubbs blocks it out
Banged in short, but this time it's too short. Called wide as it sails over and across Stubbs
Sigs it in short outside off, Ashutosh helps it along the way to deep fine leg's right
Full on leg, Stubbs clips it to midwicket
Tossed up full on leg, clipped to long-on
Finds the gap beautifully! This is tossed up full around middle and leg and Stubbs unfurls the reverse-sweep and gets it between backward point and short third
On a length on middle, punched out to cover
Full on leg, Ashutosh eases it out to deep square leg
ON a length outside off at 101kph, punched towards cover
Tossed full down leg, Stubbs clips it towards short fine and takes off for the single
Full around off, driven past the bowler towards mid-off. Easy single this time

Run out chance! It's on a length outside off, Stubbs comes down the track and punches it to cover. He was halfway down the ground, but Ashutosh sends him back. Stubbs manages to turn and get back and the throw is a poor one at the striker's end, reprieving the South African
Full around middle and off, blocked back to the bowler
On a length outside off, this time Ashutosh steers it to deep third's right

Good shot and good fielding! Short ball angling into him, Ashutosh backs away and ramps it fine on the off side. Digvesh Rathi runs across from deep third and flings himself to stop it with his extended left arm
Full on the pads, clipped out to deep midwicket
Quicker and wider outside off, 100.7kph, glided straight to short third
Googly on a length on middle and leg, he is beaten on the inside and is hit high on the front pad
Quicker and shorter outside off, he goes back to glide it but misses
Powered away over cover. Tossed up wrong'un outside off, Ashutosh does not get to the pitch of it, stays leg side and flays it over cover
The googly on off now, pushed to long-on
Booom! Looked like Stubbs was reaching for it but my word. He's made excellent contact on the extended lofted shot. Tossed up legbreak outside off, he hits it well over wide long-off
The legbreak on a length outside off, gets it off the outer half to backward point
On a length around off, pushed to cover
Goes back and punches the length ball to cover
Thick edge and it runs away. The slider on a length outside off, he goes back and hangs his bat out, but it takes the outside edge and beats short third
Length ball on leg, nudged through midwicket. Stubbs slips at the non-striker's end while turning for the second
Length ball on middle, punched down to long-on
Quicker one on  a length on middle,gets it off the inner edge towards short fine leg
Googly outside off, full in length, drives it towards Badoni at backward pint and takes a quick run

Bishnoi has his arms aloft, and that only means one thing - DC have lost another. This is in the slot on middle and leg, du Plessis slogs it in the air and does not get the distance. Goes high in the air and Miller has all the time in the world to settle under it and take it
Quicker and outside off, punched back to the bowler
Half-tracker and punished! Short and outside off, 91.4kph, he goes back and pulls it over deep midwicket
Full on middle, the wrong'un, driven back a tad aerially
Fuller on off and middle, eased down to long-on to end the powerplay. DC almost keeping up with the rate but have lost a few more wickets than they would have liked
Googly on a length, allows FdP to go back and nudge it through midwicket
Sprays it down leg, no chance for Pant to get a glove. The pace was high too, 98.9kph
Spins in from a length outside off, he clips it through midwicket

Rathi has his way and picks up his maiden IPL wicket! Axar moves across to the off side to hit it over the in-field on the leg side. It is the googly again, so the ball has slightly more distance to cover. Axar does not hit it off the middle and finds Pooran at square leg
Glorious! Axar goes inside out over cover. Backs away to the googly, has ample chance to free his arms
Spinning in from a length, clipped through backward square leg
Length ball outside off, slapped to deep cover, 13 off the over
Bangs it short outside off, he leaves it be
Goes wider with the slower one, does not get away with the wide this time, 117.6kph
Slower one full and wide outside off, 117.1kph, du Plessis lets it go anticipating a wide but that is not given
Stand and delivery, Faf style! Back of a length, 136kph, just outside off, du Plessis stands tall and hits it on the up over the sight-screen
Length ball on middle and off, Axar walks across and clips it to deep backward square leg
Away from a flying cover! Overpitched just outside off, Axar leans into it and drives it hard, away from Miller who dives to his left

Just over cover and successive boundaries for du Plessis. He was actually done in by the turn, and barely got it off the outer half. Pooran at cover-point leapt high but it was beyond his reach, 15 off the over
In the slot, du Plessis does not miss out. Fired in on leg, 102kph, he clears the front leg and hits it over the bowler's head even though long-off is back
Quicker and fuller on leg, 100.2kph, du Plessis misses the clip. Pant and Siddharth appeal but it is sliding down
Du Plessis backs away and slaps the length ball to cover
Backs away and slogs this one to deep midwicket on the bounce. It was bowled on a length at 96.9kph
Clean strike! Tossed up outside off, full in length, Axar has the room and he frees his arms to slog it well over mid-off
Beaten all ends up! Du Plessis backs away explore off, but this one keeps coming in. He looks to clip it belatedly but misses, Pant also parries it to short fine leg
Timed to perfection! Shortish and spinning in from outside off, du Plessis hangs back and punches it through cover
Shortish in length, he goes back and heaves it to deep midwicket
Bang! Axar goes straight and gets four. Full and wide outside off, he clears his front leg and belts it down the ground. Long-off was a mere spectator
Quicker one on a length on middle, 92.1kph, punched back to the bowler
Starts off with a googly on leg, he hangs back and clips it towards short fine leg
Full on off, punched to cover-point, getting Pant excited. Just two runs and a wicket
Fuller on off, flicked through midwicket

Nicked behind and Rizvi is out of here! Superb catch from Pant that. He was moving to his left, stretched both his hands towards the off side - in an attempt to effect the stumping - but managed to take it well. Rizvi went for the drive but only feathered an edge behind. Siddharth, too, strikes in his opening over
Looks to turn it across the line but gets a leading edge towards cover
Quicker and outside off, he goes hard at it but is beaten on the inside
Full on off, driven through extra cover, just one as Markram gets around quickly
